games.name: Left 4 Dead 2

games.issue: Tested with Ember's modified DXVK. Results may differ with other DXVK builds.

games.name: Lost Ark
games.environment: This Mac (M4 Pro) · FEX · DXMT · QHD · MetalFX · Ember Flow · Game Mode · Separate runs for each item
games.result: Town traversal and gameplay were tested. On October 22, FEX ran continuously for 3 hours 9 minutes with no crashes recorded.
games.issue: The first launch may take longer while FEX creates its cache. Intermittent errors remain in the game's web views.
games.fps: Earlier town measurement: game 47–54 → display 94–107 fps · Crowded scene game fps +7% (50.2 → 53.7) · Separate realignment comparison: median of 1-second maximum frame times about 23–29 → 17–20 ms

games.name: Lethal Company
games.environment: M4 Pro · 60Hz · 30 seconds after entering the ship
games.result: Visuals and performance were tested inside the ship as a LAN host.
games.issue: Internet lobbies and online co-op are outside the scope of this record. Korean characters in microphone names may appear as boxes in the game's font.
games.fps: Game 60 fps · GPU usage about 51% in this scene · Separate measurement (Rosetta · DXMT · 4K · Ember Flow): total latency 51.5 → 43.0 ms · October 21, Rosetta · D3DMetal FHD: game about 120 → display about 139 fps · October 17, FEX · DXMT FHD: display about 155 fps (maximum frame time 19.8 ms)

games.name: Resident Evil Requiem
games.environment: M4 Pro · October 4: 120Hz 4K display · October 21: FHD
games.result: The title screen, menus, and gameplay in the first room were tested with D3DMetal. It also launched normally with D3DMetal on October 21, when frame rates were measured.
games.issue: Movement stutter was recorded on October 4; maximum frame time was not recorded separately on October 21. DXMT shows a black screen, so this game uses Rosetta · D3DMetal. The FEX engine is not supported.
games.fps: October 4: about 83 fps stationary · About 70 fps moving · Moving p99 about 50 ms · October 21, FHD Ember Flow: game about 115 → display about 137 fps

games.name: Valheim
games.environment: This Mac (M4 Pro) · FEX · DXMT · FHD · 60 fps cap · Frame generation off
games.result: The intro video and menu were checked, and frame timing was measured for 60 seconds with both FEX · DXMT and Rosetta · DXMT.
games.issue: FEX translates new code, making its maximum frame time about 10 ms longer than Rosetta's. The recorded scene (menu or world) was not specified, so this does not guarantee stability throughout the world or in multiplayer.
games.fps: 60 fps · Automatic low-latency display queue: internal latency 10.2 → 5.6 ms · October 21, FEX · DXMT FHD: game 60 → display 120 fps (Ember Flow, maximum frame time 28.9 ms) · October 17, Rosetta · DXMT: also 120 fps (maximum 18.6 ms)

games.name: Stellar Blade
games.environment: M4 Pro · Demo · Separate measurements for each graphics path
games.result: Gameplay was tested with D3DMetal. FEX · DXMT and Rosetta · DXMT also ran and measured about 60 fps at FHD (October 22). An intermittent FEX screen freeze was fixed (3 of 9 runs → 0 of 7).
games.issue: Earlier DXMT runs recorded GPU hangs and visual corruption with FSR3; these were not rechecked in recent measurements. FEX maximum frame times of about 290–307 ms were traced to bringing the window to the front at measurement start (Rosetta also exceeded 600 ms). Treat these separately from D3DMetal results.
games.fps: D3DMetal · Ember Flow · 144Hz: game 60 → average display 116.7 fps · 4K D3DMetal (October 23): game about 34 → display about 55 fps · FHD DXMT (October 22): both FEX and Rosetta about 60 fps · Rosetta D3DMetal smooth mode presentation update: FHD latency 24.2 → 14.1 ms · Output 116.6 → 119.2 fps; QHD latency 24.2 → 15.8 ms · Output 114.0 → 118.8 fps · These figures do not guarantee stability

games.name: Overwatch
games.environment: M4 Pro · Steam version · QHD · User gameplay (October 10) and frame-rate measurement (October 15)
games.result: After a launch failure was fixed, the user confirmed that the game ran with Rosetta · D3DMetal.
games.issue: Measurements indicate a GPU limit at QHD, holding performance at about 56–60 fps rather than an Ember bottleneck. FEX remains unconfirmed: it produced no image on October 15 (GPU about 1%). The Korean Battle.net release has separate records; these results do not apply to it.
games.fps: QHD measurement (October 15): game about 56–60 fps · GPU usage 94–100%

games.name: Once Human
games.environment: M4 Pro · Separate measurements for each graphics path
games.result: Field gameplay and frame generation were checked. With DXMT, unique and repeated frames were also compared across frame generation methods.
games.issue: The display-output figures below were measured with D3DMetal. They are not combined with DXMT results for comparison. The FEX · DXMT run recorded 1 freeze lasting 35.6 seconds; its cause was not investigated.
games.fps: Earlier D3DMetal measurement: display about 114 fps with Ember Flow · October 16, Rosetta · D3DMetal FHD: game about 53 → display about 78 fps · October 17, FEX · DXMT FHD: about 41 fps

games.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
games.scope: DX12 version · 13 minutes in White Orchard
games.environment: This Mac (M4 Pro) · Rosetta · D3DMetal 3.0 · shader translation guard · 1080p · Medium
games.result: After entering the world through the app’s default launch path, walking, camera movement, waterside areas, buildings, combat stances and menus were checked for 13 minutes. No crashes, freezes or visual corruption occurred in this run. During automatic launch-combination testing early on October 23, the D3DMetal combination also kept its window open for 30 seconds in all 3 attempts (this was not a gameplay check).
games.issue: Stability across the full game and over long sessions has not been verified. This gameplay record is from Rosetta · D3DMetal. FEX · DXMT gameplay is outside the scope of this check.
games.fps: Medium settings: game 44–50 fps · FSR upscaling Auto · VSync · 60 fps cap

games.name: Counter-Strike 2
games.environment: This Mac (M4 Pro) · Rosetta · FHD · Borderless fullscreen · VSync off · Dust 2 offline, 0 bots
games.result: Menus, Korean text, audio, and bot matches were tested. FPS defaults prioritize latency: automatic translator DXMT, Ember Flow off, low-latency mode and Ember Spark on.
games.issue: The window is invisible in exclusive fullscreen. Use borderless fullscreen. Official matchmaking and VAC servers were not tested.
games.fps: Median input-to-display latency: DXMT 29.0 ms / D3DMetal 46.2 ms (about 17 ms apart) · Automatic image settings differ by translator, so fps is not directly compared. · Maximum frame time (FHD, October): FEX · DXMT about 60 ms, Rosetta · DXMT about 325 ms
